reason: Definition interface: diagonal action of pi_1(B,b0) on Btilde x F and its quotient foliation, with the covering-space action verified via small sets in the Btilde coordinate; well-definedness rests on the quotient-foliation proposition (level 0) and the deck-group lemma. Sources: Leiden §1.3.4/1.3.5, Meinrenken Example 2.3, Calegari Example 4.2.
